results.canonical_news_title: AI-specific employee security awareness and behavior testing

global_competitors.name: Hoxhunt
global_competitors.reason: Role/context-aware security behavior training, simulations, measurement and remediation, including AI-era threats.

global_competitors.name: KnowBe4
global_competitors.reason: Security awareness platform with AI-related training, assessments and remediation workflows.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye yapay zeka güvenlik farkındalık çalışan test senaryo
AI policy employee behavior scenario test remediation software
results.market_gap: Role-specific AI scenarios are a narrower packaging, but behavior testing/remediation is already directly served by security-awareness platforms.
results.mvp: Role-scenario builder, approved response/rationale, scoring, remediation and retest.
results.working_logic: Define internal AI rules; create role scenarios; employee chooses action; score against approved behavior; assign remediation; retest and report.
results.main_risk: Incumbents can add AI-policy scenarios easily.
results.validation_assumption: AI-specific content is differentiation, not a distinct workflow.
results.rejection_reason: Direct security behavior/training platforms substantially cover scenario testing, measurement and remediation.

global_competitors.name: Finout
global_competitors.reason: AI/cloud cost allocation, unit economics and business-value attribution across services.

global_competitors.name: CloudZero
global_competitors.reason: AI cost visibility/allocation to teams, products and business dimensions.

global_competitors.name: Vantage
global_competitors.reason: Tracks AI/LLM and cloud spend with cost allocation and optimization.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye AI maliyet yönetimi FinOps yapay zeka harcama
AI spend value governance SaaS cost allocation use case ROI
results.market_gap: A manual SME ledger is simpler, but the cost attribution/optimization job is an established FinOps/AI-cost category.
results.mvp: AI service inventory, cost-center mapping, monthly import, value register and renewal decision dashboard.
results.working_logic: Register subscriptions/services; import monthly spend; allocate to teams/use cases; record outcomes/value; flag renewal/cap/stop decisions.
results.main_risk: FinOps incumbents increasingly support AI costs.
results.validation_assumption: Manual value evidence could differentiate, but core job overlaps.
results.rejection_reason: Multiple direct platforms cover AI spend allocation, unit economics and optimization.

results.canonical_news_title: Companies can build RAG in days; making it reliable enough to run the business is much harder

global_competitors.name: LangSmith
global_competitors.reason: Direct RAG/LLM evaluation with datasets, tests, traces and regression monitoring.

global_competitors.name: Confident AI / DeepEval
global_competitors.reason: RAG evaluation, golden datasets, metrics and regression testing.

global_competitors.name: Ragas
global_competitors.reason: RAG evaluation/test framework for retrieval and answer quality.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye RAG kalite değerlendirme test golden dataset yazılımı
RAG reliability governance source freshness golden question evaluation platform
results.market_gap: Source authority/freshness governance adds a useful angle, but golden-question testing and RAG reliability are already crowded.
results.mvp: Source register, authority/freshness rules, conflict queue, permissions and golden-question tests.
results.working_logic: Register sources; set authority/expiry; flag conflicts; map access; maintain golden questions; run/manual-score regression checks.
results.main_risk: Evaluation incumbents can extend source governance.
results.validation_assumption: No paid LLM/API means automated answer testing would be limited; manual tests remain possible.
results.rejection_reason: Direct RAG evaluation platforms substantially cover the reliability/golden-test core job.

results.canonical_news_title: Docker Sandboxes move to cloud / long-running agent execution

global_competitors.name: Daytona
global_competitors.reason: Infrastructure/control plane for isolated agent execution environments with lifecycle management.

global_competitors.name: E2B
global_competitors.reason: Cloud sandboxes for long-running AI agents with execution/session management.

global_competitors.name: Docker
global_competitors.reason: Triggering ecosystem increasingly provides cloud sandbox lifecycle itself.

competition_search_terms: coding agent long running sandbox job management handoff observability
cloud agent sandbox session lifecycle operations dashboard
results.market_gap: The handoff ledger is narrower, but sandbox providers already own environment/session lifecycle and are moving toward observability/control.
results.mvp: Agent-job registry, sandbox metadata, checkpoints, handoff log, artifact links, budget/time guards and cleanup queue.
results.working_logic: Create delegated job; link sandbox; record owner/budget/checkpoints; capture artifact/handoff; flag stale jobs; close and clean environment.
results.main_risk: Native sandbox platforms can absorb this workflow quickly.
results.validation_assumption: Manual links avoid paid APIs but reduce automation.
results.rejection_reason: Direct sandbox platforms substantially overlap long-running agent environment/session lifecycle management.

adjacent_competitors.name: Churnkey
adjacent_competitors.reason: Cancellation/retention optimization for human self-service flows; not readiness for external consumer agents.

adjacent_competitors.name: CancellationFlow
adjacent_competitors.reason: Cancellation flow and retention tooling, human-user oriented.

adjacent_competitors.name: ChurnFree
adjacent_competitors.reason: Retention/cancellation workflow optimization, not agent-mediated policy/readiness.

competition_search_terms: Türkiye abonelik iptal churn retention yazılımı AI agent
subscription business readiness AI agent cancellation machine readable policy retention
results.market_gap: Fresh search found many cancellation/retention products but no direct product whose core job is making a subscription business's cancellation/save policies and evidence consumable/governable when an external consumer AI agent performs the cancellation.
results.mvp: Cancellation-path inventory, machine-readable policy checklist, save-offer rules and agent-origin churn evidence.
results.working_logic: Map every cancellation channel and policy; define machine-readable eligibility/save rules; test agent path manually; record agent-origin reason/outcome; review leakage and policy failures.
results.marketing_strategy: Agentic-commerce/consumer-agent SEO; retention consultants and subscription SaaS communities.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with 5 subscription SaaS businesses by auditing their cancellation path from an agent perspective.
results.main_risk: Market may be early and standards may change rapidly.
results.validation_assumption: Businesses will distinguish agent-origin cancellation traffic and need policy governance separate from existing churn tooling.
